subject: Elementary School Overcrowding Review
overview: The School Committee approved tuition increases for before and after-school care and updated the district graduation policy. The committee also initiated a formal review of elementary school overcrowding and enrollment inequities, referring the data collection and solution planning to the Strategic Planning Subcommittee.

items.title: Before and After School Tuition Rates
items.summary: Approved 3% tuition rate increases for both before and after-school programs for the 2025-2026 school year to keep pace with staff wages.

items.title: Quarterly Budget Transfers
items.summary: Approved budget transfers totaling $138,431.25 to align program codes and account for departmental overspending at the end of the fiscal year.

items.title: Policy IKF: Graduation Requirements
items.summary: Approved the second reading of Policy IKF, which clarifies graduation requirements, commencement participation for students with IEPs, and updates math program language.

items.title: Elementary School Overcrowding Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Strategic Planning Subcommittee that directs administration to provide a comprehensive report on elementary school overcrowding and enrollment data by May 19, 2025. The committee discussed the urgent need for short-term solutions at Roberts Elementary School alongside long-term redistricting considerations.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Recognized the passing of former crossing guard Sophie Marie Santoro and Constance Sullivan before adjourning.
